name: Balanced — weak market
notes: RSI(14) under 35 is real weakness, not just a soft week, so this buys a moderately larger cover over a moderate window.

name: Balanced — calm market
notes: RSI(14) over 35 is an ordinary market, so this holds a smaller, shorter cover rather than none. An RSI reading of exactly 35 matches neither band -- a known, accepted gap, not a bug.
